title: Denominator Dash
one_liner: Race the $40T national debt against AI-boosted GDP growth and watch debt-to-GDP rise or collapse.
headline: Drag three sliders (or tap a preset) to race the $40T US debt against AI-boosted GDP growth and watch a live gauge show whether debt-to-GDP rises or falls by 2040.

episode.title: Chamath: AGI Is Here, Anthropic’s $100B Giveaway, Elon’s SpaceX Shares for 72M Kids | EP #304

history.summary: A tight, well-executed single-idea demo: an animated line race plus a speedometer gauge makes the debt-vs-GDP dynamic legible in seconds, and three presets map directly onto the episode's historic/Anthropic/Elon framing. The build is notably careful about honesty — it already caught and fixed its own mistake (per the changelog) of implying the $30T GDP baseline was a podcast figure, and now clearly separates verified stat-strip numbers from the labeled illustrative baseline and derived growth rate.
